name: Outbound Stack Set-up
description: The tools, configuration, and connections your team needs to run outbound—from a new setup to a rebuild of what you already use.
headline: Set up your outbound tools.
intro: We review your sales process, existing tools, and budget, then configure the systems your team needs to research prospects, manage outreach, and track activity.
audience: Companies starting outbound, equipping their first sales team, or replacing a fragmented setup.
scope: Tool selection based on requirements and budget.
Basic CRM fields, ownership rules, and pipeline configuration needed for outbound.
Standard integrations between the selected tools.
outcome: A configured, connected, and tested outbound environment that the team can use.
boundary: This service covers the outbound stack and its standard configuration. Complex custom workflows belong in Outbound Automation. Wider CRM migrations and sales-process redesign belong in CRM Implementation & Sales Operations.
label: Implementation project

name: Outbound Automation
description: Connect your tools and automate repetitive sales work, including research, enrichment, lead routing, CRM updates, and follow-up tasks.
headline: Automate research, routing, and CRM updates.
intro: We map the repetitive steps in your sales process and build workflows that move information between systems, with clear rules, review points, and error handling.
audience: Teams that already have sales tools but still rely on manual research, spreadsheet transfers, inconsistent updates, and repetitive administration.
scope: Campaign enrolment based on agreed rules and approvals.
Reply notifications and follow-up task creation.
Error alerts, testing, documentation, and handover.
outcome: A defined set of working automations that reduces repetitive handling and keeps the sales process consistent.
boundary: Automation executes agreed rules. It does not guarantee replies or meetings. We include human approval where judgement or external communication requires it.
engagement: Scoped implementation based on the workflows and integrations required.
label: Workflow implementation

name: Outbound Intelligence
description: Build a research and monitoring system that identifies suitable accounts and surfaces relevant developments in your market.
headline: Research accounts and monitor your market.
intro: We build intelligence systems around your target market, combining account research, relevant sources, and monitoring rules to deliver useful findings to your sales team.
audience: Teams that need better account prioritisation, ongoing market research, or visibility into developments across target companies.
scope: Monitoring of agreed developments, such as new projects, tenders, expansion, hiring, or leadership changes.
Relevant contact or role identification where information is available.
Source links, dates, and an explanation of relevance.
Delivery into an agreed destination, such as a CRM, shared sheet, Slack, or email.
outcome: An organised research and monitoring process that helps the team decide where to focus its attention.
boundary: A relevant company event is not proof of buying intent. Findings include source links and dates, with sourced facts clearly separated from interpretations. Public announcements are starting points for investigation, not confirmed purchase opportunities.
engagement: Initial implementation, with optional recurring monitoring and maintenance.
label: Implementation + optional monitoring

name: CRM Implementation & Sales Operations
description: Configure your CRM around how your team sells, with clear pipelines, reliable data, ownership rules, reporting, and handovers.
headline: Implement or reorganise your CRM.
intro: We implement or reorganise your CRM so your team can manage accounts, follow opportunities, and understand what needs attention.
audience: Companies introducing a CRM, moving from spreadsheets, or working with inconsistent data and poorly defined sales processes.
scope: Account, contact, lead, and deal structures.
Data validation, documentation, and team training.
outcome: A usable CRM with clear operating rules, organised information, and reporting aligned with the sales process.
boundary: This is broader than the basic CRM configuration included in Outbound Stack Set-up. Migration volume, integration complexity, and process changes are agreed during scoping.
label: Implementation or improvement

name: Managed Outbound Operations
description: Ongoing support to maintain your outbound systems, monitor workflows, manage data quality, and improve the operation as your needs change.
headline: Maintain your outbound systems.
intro: We provide ongoing operational support for your sales systems, so your team has someone responsible for maintenance, checks, and agreed improvements.
audience: Teams with an existing outbound setup that need continued operational support but do not need a full-time internal specialist.
scope: Campaign configuration and launch checks where agreed.
outcome: A maintained sales operation with defined responsibilities and a clear process for addressing issues and improvements.
boundary: Cold calling, daily inbox handling, appointment setting, and closing are not included unless separately agreed. Responsibilities, capacity, and support arrangements are defined in advance; meetings and business outcomes are not guaranteed.
engagement: Monthly service with clearly defined responsibilities, capacity, and support arrangements.
label: Monthly operational support
